notes.title: Mathematics: Coordinate Geometry & Conic Sections (Parabola, Ellipse, Hyperbola)
notes.subject: Mathematics

sections.heading: 1. Eccentricity, Latus Rectum & Slope-Form Tangents
bullets: Parabola (y² = 4ax): LR = 4a, Tangent of slope m: y = mx + a/m
Ellipse (x²/a² + y²/b² = 1): b² = a²(1 − e²), LR = 2b²/a, Tangent: y = mx ± √(a²m² + b²)
Hyperbola (x²/a² − y²/b² = 1): b² = a²(e² − 1), Tangent: y = mx ± √(a²m² − b²)

notes.title: Chemistry: Chemical & Ionic Equilibrium, Buffer & Ksp Master Sheet
notes.subject: Chemistry

sections.heading: 1. Kp vs Kc, Van’t Hoff & Henderson-Hasselbalch Buffer Equations
bullets: Kp = Kc · (RT)^(Δn_g) | ΔG° = −2.303 R T log₁₀(K_eq)
Acidic Buffer pH = pK_a + log₁₀([Salt]/[Acid]) | Basic Buffer pOH = pK_b + log₁₀([Salt]/[Base])
Solubility Product for A_x B_y: K_sp = x^x · y^y · S^(x+y)

notes.title: Physics: Rotational Motion, Moment of Inertia & Pure Rolling Sheet
notes.subject: Physics

sections.heading: 1. Moment of Inertia & Parallel / Perpendicular Axis Theorems
bullets: Moment of Inertia: I = Σ m_i r_i² = ∫ r² dm [SI Unit: kg·m², Dimensional Formula: M¹L²T⁰]
Parallel Axis Theorem: I = I_cm + M d² (where d is perpendicular distance between parallel axes)
Perpendicular Axis Theorem (Planar 2D Laminas): I_z = I_x + I_y
Standard Values: Thin Rod (center) = ML²/12, (end) = ML²/3 | Ring = MR² | Solid Disc = ½ MR² | Solid Sphere = ⅖ MR²

sections.heading: 2. Torque, Angular Momentum & Pure Rolling on Incline
bullets: Torque & Angular Momentum: τ = r × F = I α = dL/dt | Conservation: If Σ τ_ext = 0, then I₁ ω₁ = I₂ ω₂
Pure Rolling Condition (no slipping): v_cm = R ω and a_cm = R α
Acceleration Rolling Down Incline (angle θ): a = (g sin θ) / (1 + k²/R²)
